text: {A Song of Ascents} {God Defeats Israel's Enemies} d "Since my youth they have often persecuted me,"let Israel repeat it,
"Since my youth they have often persecuted me, yet they haven't defeated me.
Wicked people {So LXX DSS 11QPs a; MT reads The ploughman} ploughed over my back, creating long-lasting wounds." {Or long furrows; LXX reads back; they prolonged their lawlessness}
The Lord is righteous he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.
Let all who hate Zion be turned away and be ashamed.
May they become like a tuft of grass on a roof top, that withers before it takes root
not enough to fill one's hand or to bundle in one's arms.
And may those who pass by never tell them, "May the Lord's blessing be upon you. We bless you in the name of the Lord."
